name: larijani-stone-theme
description: Build tooling for the Larijani Stone WordPress / Elementor theme

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:vendor
scripts.build:js: terser assets/js/theme.js -c -m --comments false -o assets/js/theme.min.js && terser assets/js/admin.js -c -m --comments false -o assets/js/admin.min.js
